LDMARKD.Settings.ModuleEnabled.Name: Condition Watch Enabled
LDMARKD.Settings.ModuleEnabled.Hint: Whether players can currently see NPC/monster condition details. Toggled live via the Condition Watch button in the Token scene controls.
LDMARKD.Settings.ShowControlButton.Name: Show Scene Control Button
LDMARKD.Settings.ShowControlButton.Hint: Show the Condition Watch toggle button in the Token scene controls toolbar (GM only). Turning this off hides the button, but does not by itself disable the feature.
LDMARKD.Controls.Toggle.Title: Toggle Condition Watch
